messages:
Aisha (Product): kicking off a short thread to align on the Optimize toolkit & evals roadmap for the next planning cycle. goal: decide scope for Q3 pilot vs Q4 full launch, and pin launch criteria.
Diego (Eng-ML): +1. main engineering risk is the continuous regression detector — we need a clear spec for how evals surface regressions automatically.
Sam (Eng-Platform): also need to decide whether recommendations run in-console only or expose an API. API adds work but customers asked for programmatic recs. @Aisha
Priya (Solutions): customer asks: templated batching/caching suggestions that map to current SDKs, and an easy way to run our prompt sets against prod traffic. they want actionable suggestions not just numbers.
Karen (Customer Success): we have 3 paying customers who already asked for per-route batching recs + guardrails for changes. willing to pilot in exchange for early access.
Victor (Research): propose two parts: 1) metric suite for regressions (quality delta + latency/cost delta), 2) prompt-set authoring + canonical examples. for regressions: use A/B on heldback traffic and compute delta with bootstrap CI.
Diego (Eng-ML): rough engineering scope: regression detector (streaming diffs + alerting), prompt-set runner (batch replays), recommendations engine (rules + ML suggestions). estimate: 3 sprints for MVP if we cut auto-quantize suggestions.
Aisha (Product): ok trade-off: drop auto-quantization & model-rewriting from MVP; include it in Q4. MVP = batching/caching recs, prompt-set runner, regression alerts + Console UI + opt-in API.
Sam (Eng-Platform): note: Console integration needs route-level signals (tokens per request, avg seq len) — we need telemetry schema. can we commit log format by end of sprint 1?
Aisha (Product): yes, telemetry schema draft by week 2 of sprint 1. Sam, Diego pair on schema.
Priya (Solutions): Launch criteria suggestion: 1) Pilot with 3 customers for 4 weeks; 2) regression detector must have <= 5% false-positive rate on our internal evals; 3) recommendations show >= 5% token cost reduction in at least 2 pilot customers or equivalent simulation.
Victor (Research): also require that quality regressions flagged have a triage workflow in Console (link to prompt set + diff) — otherwise alerts are noise.
Karen (Customer Success): pilots: CustA, CustB, CustC ok. I'll coordinate contracts. They want a rollback knob.
Diego (Eng-ML): engineering note: rollback knob means we need immediate policy to revert recommendations and an audit log. low effort to add.
Aisha (Product): timeline proposal: sprint 0 (design/spec) 2 weeks, sprint 1-2 (build) 6 weeks, sprint 3 (pilot + iteration) 4 weeks. target pilot start: 2024-08-05.
Sam (Eng-Platform): dependencies: logging infra + rollout hooks. I'll put a ticket for rollout API.
Priya (Solutions): for prompt-sets: canonical templates + a small UI to curate per-customer prompt sets. keep authoring simple (YAML upload + UI).
Victor (Research): evals: we'll ship a baseline suite (n=50 prompts per vertical) and a tutorial for customers to add their own. automated CI to run nightly on pinned model versions.
Aisha (Product): OKRs alignment: tie this initiative to OKR: Reduce inference $/req by 10% for top 20% routes and improve regression detection coverage to 90%.
Diego (Eng-ML): blockers? compute for nightly replays might be heavy. suggest replay sampling + cached KV reuse.
Sam (Eng-Platform): we can apply replay sampling and leverage existing dedicated infra for pilots. need cost estimate; I'll add to ticket.
Aisha (Product): decision summary: MVP scope confirmed (batching/caching recs, prompt-set runner, regression detector, Console UI, opt-in API). cut auto-quantization & advanced model-rewrites to Q4. launch criteria = Priya's + Victor's triage requirement.
Priya (Solutions): noted. will draft pilot plan and runbook.
Karen (Customer Success): I'll send pilot invites this week.
ops-bot: Reminder: sprint planning meeting scheduled for Mon 09:30 in #eng-releases.
Aisha (Product): thanks all. I'll post the spec doc next and ping for feedback. :rocket:
